svg.title: Health checks
svg.desc: A load balancer sends GET /health to three web servers every second. Web 2 stops answering, fails three checks in a row and is taken out of rotation, so requests go only to Web 1 and Web 3. Web 2 then passes two checks in a row and is added back.
svg.text: Web 2 fails three checks and leaves rotation. Two passes and it rejoins.
